text: RBI's Master Direction on Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts does not permit the levy of an annual maintenance charge on a BSBDA.
A Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account carries no minimum balance requirement, and no penal charge may be levied for non-maintenance of balance.
Where an unauthorised electronic transaction arises from third-party breach and is reported within three working days, the customer's liability is nil and the amount must be reversed.
The amount involved in a disputed electronic transaction must be shadow-credited to the customer's account within ten working days of notification.
A complaint is maintainable before the RBI Ombudsman only after a written complaint has first been made to the regulated entity.
A complaint to the Ombudsman must be made within ninety days of the regulated entity's reply, or of the lapse of the period allowed for that reply.
A regulated entity has thirty days to reply to a written complaint before the matter may be escalated to the Ombudsman.
The Ombudsman shall not entertain a complaint where the subject matter is pending before, or has been decided by, any court, tribunal or arbitrator.
A grievance arising out of a regulated entity's commercial judgement or business decision is outside the Ombudsman's jurisdiction.
Banks are required to appoint an Internal Ombudsman to whom partly or wholly rejected complaints are automatically escalated before the customer is given a final reply.
Section 7(1) of the Right to Information Act 2005 requires a Public Information Officer to dispose of a request within thirty days of receipt.
Section 19(1) of the Right to Information Act 2005 allows a first appeal to the designated Appellate Authority within thirty days of the PIO's decision or of the expiry of the response period.
